# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-29

This Xteink X4 Pro release fixes Calibre catalog discovery during full library synchronization.

## Fixed

- Fixed synchronization failing when Calibre requires a `library_id` parameter for catalog requests.
- The firmware now discovers Calibre's Newest catalog from the server's OPDS root feed.
- Supports arbitrary Calibre library names without hardcoding the server's library identifier.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 Pro only.
- The OTA binary is published through the self-hosted CrossPoint release service.
